headline: 2012 order lets the US freeze the property of people seen as threatening Yemen's peace, security, or stability.
what_it_does: This executive order allows the US government to block, or freeze, property and assets in the United States belonging to people found to threaten the peace, security, or stability of Yemen. Frozen property generally cannot be moved, sold, or used. Orders of this kind usually also bar Americans from doing business with the people named. No official summary was provided, so details beyond the title are limited.

who_it_affects.group: People and groups found to threaten Yemen's peace, security, or stability
who_it_affects.how: Their property and assets under US control can be frozen.
They may be barred from dealing with, or handling property of, people whose assets are blocked.
